friday-night-funkin.title: Friday Night Funkin' - Free Online Rhythm Game
friday-night-funkin.slogan: Prove Your Skills in Epic Rap Battles!
friday-night-funkin.description: Friday Night Funkin' is a thrilling rhythm game where you compete in rap battles to win your girlfriend's heart. With 8 challenging chapters, face off against seasoned musicians like Daddy Dearest and Skid & Pump. Press the arrows in sync with the music to keep the rhythm and hit every note. Perfect your skills in story mode or practice in freeplay mode. Dive into the world of Friday Night Funkin' and show off your rhythm!

HomeIframe.title: Friday Night Funkin' - Rhythm Battles
HomeIframe.description: Experience the excitement of Friday Night Funkin' with intense rhythm battles and challenging opponents. Perfect your timing and rhythm to win!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Friday Night Funkin' is a music and rhythm game where you compete in rap battles to win your girlfriend's heart. Face off against her father, a seasoned musician, and other challenging opponents.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Press the arrows at the right time to produce the right sound.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Keep the rhythm throughout the songs and miss as few notes as possible.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Win rap battles against various opponents in story mode or practice in freeplay mode.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Face off against a variety of opponents, each with their own unique style and rhythm.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Progress through 8 weeks of intense rap battles to win your girlfriend's heart.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Practice each song individually to perfect your timing and rhythm.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Choose from three levels of difficulty, with hard mode offering an extreme challenge.
